name: obscura-browser
description: Stealth Obscura headless browser as a system-wide MCP (35 browser_* tools) that gets past Cloudflare. Bundles the Docker build (Obscura compiled --features stealth for real Chrome TLS/JA4), a supergateway HTTP gateway that injects server-level usage instructions, the /obscura:start setup command, and the driving-obscura skill.
